summary: The review found that the proposed evidence path does not yet exist: `select_tests` reports plans and exit codes, while closeout has no structured test-result source. The main risks are missing task-declared tests in the final run, stale or duplicated aggregates, ledger side effects, unbounded failures, and drift across three maintained `/sdd-done` variants.

suggestions.title: Introduce a typed, versioned test-result model
suggestions.rationale: `TaskCompletionEvidence.completion_facts` is an unconstrained dictionary, and `finalize_task.py` renders arbitrary values as strings. Define a strict summary model containing run identity, suite, counts, duration, outcome, and provenance so zero, unknown, skipped, and failed are not conflated.

suggestions.title: Specify report-file semantics for multi-distribution runs
suggestions.rationale: `select_tests.py` currently supports `--json`, but that serializes only `ScopePlan`; `--run` executes one subprocess per distribution without capturing result data. A single `--junitxml` path would also collide across invocations, so define a report directory or deterministic per-distribution filenames and a stable aggregate JSON schema.

suggestions.title: Pass every task file into the final feature-tier selection
suggestions.rationale: `plan_tests` includes declared validation commands only when the CLI receives `--task-file`; the proposed closeout command omits those files, so its feature run becomes mirror/core coverage rather than the union of every task’s declared tests. `/sdd-done` should derive all task files from the per-spec index and pass them explicitly, or label the result as incomplete.

suggestions.title: Bind every report to the exact tested revision
suggestions.rationale: The current plan JSON has no base ref, HEAD SHA, or plan hash, while `changed_files()` can return an empty list after git failures. Persist `base_ref`, `head_sha`, selected argv, marker expression, and report hash; compare `head_sha` with the post-lint HEAD before labeling a run authoritative.

suggestions.title: Persist structured results through durable evidence references
suggestions.rationale: `ExecutionEvidenceStore` already provides immutable content-addressed artifacts outside worktrees, whereas `/sdd-done` later removes the worktree. The fallback JSON should be stored as a durable artifact and referenced from task validation evidence; completion-note text should be a rendering, not the source of truth.

suggestions.title: Prevent report-only closeout runs from mutating the escalation ledger
suggestions.rationale: `select_tests --run` records green and red core/cap escalation outcomes. Invoking it from `/sdd-done` therefore changes future selection state even though the design says the report must never block. Add an explicit no-ledger mode for closeout or make ledger recording opt-in and test that mode.

suggestions.title: Make timeout and report failures explicit but non-blocking
suggestions.rationale: The CLI uses `subprocess.run` without a process timeout; its optional `--timeout` is appended as a pytest plugin argument and does not cover collection or process hangs. Closeout needs bounded execution and explicit `timed_out`, `unknown`, `selection_error`, and `report_parse_error` states, while only ordinary test failures remain advisory.

suggestions.title: Define retry and aggregation semantics before rendering totals
suggestions.rationale: `summary.py` treats every attempt as additive and sums duration, but a task may have retries or multiple validation runs. The report must identify task, attempt, run, and source, and distinguish invocation totals from unique test-case totals; otherwise retries inflate the Total row and make comparisons misleading.

suggestions.title: Test parser and closeout behavior with adversarial result shapes
suggestions.rationale: Existing selector tests cover exit codes, plans, and escalation bookkeeping, while supervisor tests cover terminal status and bounded logs; neither verifies parsed counts. Add fixtures for passed/failed/skipped/errors, collection failures, no invocations, malformed XML/JSON, xdist output, duplicate task runs, stale HEAD, timeout, and report-parser failure.

suggestions.title: Use selector cost signals instead of a hidden ten-task cutoff
suggestions.rationale: The existing selector already models impact caps, core fan-in, distribution escalation, and xdist safety. A raw task-count threshold does not predict runtime; if the cutoff remains, report `final_run: not_run` with its reason for larger specs and never imply final-HEAD coverage.

suggestions.title: Centralize report assembly across all closeout mirrors and fallbacks
suggestions.rationale: The repository maintains `.claude/commands`, `.agent/workflows`, and `.agents/skills` variants, and the current manual `gh pr create` fallback uses a placeholder body. Generate one deterministic body through an executable helper, have all variants call it, and make the fallback print or reference the exact generated body; extend the existing twin contract test to verify the table and fallback.
